gallery.filename: Residence Hall (University of Texas at Dallas).jpg
gallery.title: File:Residence Hall (University of Texas at Dallas).jpg
gallery.source: Residence Hall (University of Texas at Dallas)
gallery.description: UT Dallas Residence Hall South. A 148,000-square-foot (13,700 m2) residence hall providing housing for 384 full-time freshmen residents. The residence hall offers living learning environments that group students with similar interests and majors. The building includes a mix of three-bedroom, single-bath suites for freshmen and one-bedroom, one-bath units for peer advisers. On each wing and each floor are several communal study areas, and the ground floor features a 1,800-square-foot (170 m2) glass-enclosed rotunda with pool and ping-pong tables, a large-screen television, couches and chairs. The building also has two classrooms for freshmen-level classes.
